projects.name: Project Description
details: The objective of this project was to develop a centralized Trade Lifecycle Dashboard to provide end- to-end visibility of trade activities across multiple asset classes. The dashboard enabled Front Office,
Middle Office, Operations, and Management teams to monitor trade status from execution through settlement by consolidating trade information from multiple upstream and downstream systems.
The solution helped improve operational efficiency by reducing manual monitoring, identifying failed
trades, tracking settlement exceptions, monitoring KPIs, and providing real-time trade status across
the complete trade lifecycle.
Responsibilities
• Gathered business requirements from Front Office, Middle Office, Operations, Risk,
Compliance, and Business stakeholders.
• Conducted requirement elicitation workshops to understand existing trade lifecycle
processes and reporting requirements.
• Prepared Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Requirement Documents
(FRD), and Solution Documents.
• Created User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and maintained Product Backlog in Jira.
• Documented AS-IS and TO-BE business process flows for Trade Lifecycle reporting.
• Performed Gap Analysis to identify process inefficiencies and automation opportunities.
• Worked with stakeholders to define dashboard requirements, KPIs, filters, reports, and
business rules.
• Collaborated with Solution Architects and Development teams to translate business
requirements into functional specifications.
• Analyzed the complete Trade Lifecycle, including Trade Capture, Trade Validation, Trade
Enrichment, Allocation, Confirmation, Clearing, Settlement, and Reporting.
• Worked on OTC Derivatives and Capital Market trade workflows.
• Performed data mapping between source applications and dashboard reporting tables.
• Defined functional requirements for trade status tracking, settlement monitoring, exception
management, and operational reporting.
• Worked closely with data teams to validate trade data accuracy across multiple systems.
• Supported API integration discussions for real-time trade status updates between
applications.
• Participated in SQL data validation to verify dashboard reports and business calculations.
• Created process flow diagrams, business workflow documentation, and functional
specifications.
• Coordinated with QA teams during SIT to validate functional requirements.
• Prepared UAT scenarios and supported business users during User Acceptance Testing.
• Logged defects, prioritized issues, and coordinated with developers until successful
resolution.
• Validated dashboard reports against business expectations before production deployment.
• Managed change requests and analyzed business impact for new dashboard enhancements.
• Conducted stakeholder walkthrough sessions and requirement review meetings.
• Participated in Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, and Sprint Retrospective
meetings.
• Supported production deployment, smoke testing, and post-production issue resolution.
• Collaborated with Operations teams to ensure dashboard functionality aligned with daily
trade processing activities.
• Worked closely with Project Managers and Product Owners to prioritize business
requirements and deliver project milestones on schedule.

projects.name: Project Description
details: Worked in Investment Banking Operations supporting OTC Derivatives and Trade Lifecycle processes
for global financial markets. Responsible for ensuring smooth execution of post-trade operational
activities including trade validation, reconciliation, settlement support, exception management,
reporting, and stakeholder coordination while maintaining operational accuracy and regulatory
compliance.
Responsibilities
• Managed end-to-end post-trade operational activities for OTC Derivatives transactions.
• Monitored the complete Trade Lifecycle from trade booking through settlement and
reporting.
• Performed trade validation to ensure transaction details were accurate before downstream
processing.
• Supported trade settlement activities by coordinating with internal operations teams and
counterparties.
• Investigated trade exceptions and worked towards timely resolution to avoid settlement
failures.
• Performed daily cash, trade, and position reconciliations to identify and resolve operational
breaks.
• Coordinated with Front Office, Middle Office, and Back Office teams for trade-related queries
and issue resolution.
• Monitored settlement status and escalated critical exceptions within defined SLA timelines.
• Supported collateral-related operational activities and verified transaction details whenever
required.
• Maintained static data and reference data accuracy for smooth trade processing.
Environment
Domain: Investment Banking | OTC Derivatives
Function: Trade Lifecycle Operations
Tools: Excel, Outlook, Internal Banking Applications
